title: 小学二年级
description: 适合7-8岁孩子，拼读规则巩固、简单阅读起步、生活对话扩展
descriptionEn: For children aged 7-8. Phonics consolidation, early reading start, expanded daily conversations.

items.description: 字母积木中后段，引入长元音、辅音组合等进阶拼读规则，适合已有基础的孩子。
items.descriptionEn: Later seasons of Alphablocks introducing long vowels, consonant blends and advanced phonics rules for kids with foundation.

items.description: 单词变成实物形状拼出角色，看字即识物，拼写到阅读的自然过渡。
items.descriptionEn: Words transform into object shapes to form characters. Natural transition from spelling to reading. See the word, see the thing.

items.description: 四个童话角色用阅读超能力解决故事里的难题，自然融入字母、拼读和阅读理解。
items.descriptionEn: Four fairytale characters use reading superpowers to solve story problems. Naturally integrates letters, phonics, and reading comprehension.

items.description: 小精灵和小仙子的魔法日常，句型比布鲁伊稍简单，适合从短句向长句过渡。
items.descriptionEn: Daily magic life of a little elf and fairy. Sentence patterns slightly simpler than Bluey, great transition from short to longer sentences.

items.description: 家喻户晓的佩奇一家，生活场景丰富，对话自然流畅，小学低年级听力训练经典素材。
items.descriptionEn: The beloved Pig family. Rich daily life scenes, natural fluent dialogue. Classic listening material for lower primary grades.

items.description: 消防员山姆和庞蒂潘迪镇的救援故事，安全常识+职业词汇+紧急场景对话。
items.descriptionEn: Fireman Sam and rescue stories in Pontypandy. Safety knowledge, occupation vocabulary and emergency scenario dialogue.

items.description: 真人儿童冒险游戏秀，Captain Sinker教Cook和Line当真正海盗，互动感强，指令类英语密集。
items.descriptionEn: Live children's adventure game show. Captain Sinker teaches Cook and Line to be real pirates. Strong interaction, dense command English.

items.description: 女赛车手格蕾丝带娃认识太阳能车、救护车、清障车等，机械词汇极佳。
items.descriptionEn: Female racer Grace introduces kids to solar cars, ambulances, wreckers, etc. Excellent mechanical vocabulary.

items.description: 各国小朋友在厨房做家乡菜，食材与烹饪词汇+多元文化，适合亲子一起看。
items.descriptionEn: Kids from various countries cook hometown dishes in the kitchen. Ingredients and cooking vocabulary plus multicultural content, great for parent-child viewing.

items.description: 四名实习探险员环游世界，地理与文化知识融入冒险，指令类词汇多。
items.descriptionEn: Four trainee explorers travel the world. Geography and cultural knowledge integrated into adventures, lots of command vocabulary.

items.description: 狗狗老师带小动物完成趣味任务，社交对话丰富，拥抱徽章环节讨喜。
items.descriptionEn: Dog teacher leads little animals to complete fun tasks. Rich social dialogue, popular hug badge segment.
